name: Tomb of the Nameless Warrior
desc:
Tomb of the Nameless Warrior is a cavern that is home to a single Rotskipper. A hidden door behind the Rotskipper can be broken open with any destructible Mantra. It is an Authority Stronghold disguised as a place of rest, however it appears the Etrean military have become aware of this and have destroyed sections of it, though are yet to find the segment hidden behind the door.

The entrance can be found on a shore around the rear of [Erisia](location:erisia).

This location has Erisore in abundance, an ore primarily used to craft certain Outfits.
additional_info: -   Most likely a reference to the "Tomb of the Unknown Soldier" in Washington D.C.
